no_blood_on_the_risers_desc: finish COUNTDOWN on VERY HARD without any player ever going to bleed out
no_blood_on_the_risers_objective: finish COUNTDOWN on VERY HARD without any player ever going to bleed out
let_them_watch_desc: finish TRAIN WRECK on VERY HARD without killing any snipers or spotters
let_them_watch_objective: finish TRAIN WRECK on VERY HARD without killing any snipers or spotters
blammosweep_desc: finish GOLD RUSH on VERY HARD with all gold, greed items and dogtags secured
blammosweep_objective: finish GOLD RUSH on VERY HARD with all gold, greed items and dogtags secured
cant_take_it_anymore_desc: jump from the very top of the bridge in TRAIN WRECK and die from the fall
cant_take_it_anymore_objective: jump from the very top of the bridge in TRAIN WRECK and die from the fall
protect_lange_desc: finish WIRETAP on VERY HARD with Lange still alive
protect_lange_objective: WIRETAP on VERY HARD (raid only, not as part of an operation): finish the mission with Lange still alive. Lange dies when enemies reach his radio tower, so hold them off until he is done. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
for_the_motherland_desc: kill both generals in STRONGPOINT with russian weapons (kills by your team count)
for_the_motherland_objective: STRONGPOINT (raid only, not as part of an operation): kill both Soviet generals with russian weapons (Tokarev TT-33, Mosin Nagant, Degtyaryov DP-28). Kills by anyone count, so your teammates and the bots may do one or both, as long as both kills were made with a russian weapon. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
perfect_cut_desc: cut a bomb fuse completely, without a single miss
perfect_cut_objective: Cut a bomb fuse in the cutting minigame without a single miss: hit every cut point until the fuse is completely cut. A miss or leaving the minigame ends the attempt, so only a full run counts. Works in any mission with a fuse and on any difficulty. Everyone earns this one for their own cuts.
deutschland_den_deutschen_desc: kill the officer in FULL STOP with a german weapon
deutschland_den_deutschen_objective: FULL STOP (raid only, not as part of an operation): kill the officer with a german weapon (C96 Mauser, MP 38, StG 44, Karabiner 98k, MG 42, Double-Barrel, Parabellum P08, M24 grenade, Concrete grenade, 343d grenade, Gold Bar, Spring Mine, German Knuckleduster). The final blow counts, no matter who dealt the earlier damage: a teammate or bot with a german weapon also works. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
hans_forget_the_flammenwerfer_desc: get put down by the fire of a flamer's incendiary grenade
hans_forget_the_flammenwerfer_objective: Get put down by the fire pool an incendiary grenade thrown by a flamer leaves on the ground. The fire of the flamethrower itself does not count. Works in any mission and on any difficulty.
dont_be_so_whiney_desc: destroy all wine barrels in FIRESTARTER on HARD
dont_be_so_whiney_objective: FIRESTARTER on HARD or VERY HARD (the castle of operation Rhinegold): destroy every wine barrel of the objective. Barrels destroyed by anyone or by the fire count. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
sicher_ist_sicher_desc: destroy all rockets in COUNTDOWN on HARD
sicher_ist_sicher_objective: COUNTDOWN on HARD or VERY HARD (raid only, not as part of an operation): blow up every rocket with a red tip that stands in the silo. Rockets destroyed by anyone count. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
dont_you_dare_to_explode_desc: secure all gold of the trucks in FOREST CONVOY on HARD
dont_you_dare_to_explode_objective: FOREST CONVOY on HARD or VERY HARD (raid only, not as part of an operation): secure all the gold of the trucks. Gold lost with an exploded truck can't be secured. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
this_is_seeadler_desc: secure all gold of the train in TRAIN WRECK on VERY HARD
this_is_seeadler_objective: TRAIN WRECK on VERY HARD (raid only, not as part of an operation): secure all the gold of the train. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
assault_mastery_desc: bring every warcry, boost and talent of the Assault class to its highest tier
assault_mastery_objective: Bring every warcry, boost and talent of the Assault class (2 warcries, 6 boosts, 23 talents) to tier 4. It is enough to do this on one Assault character, and it counts for the whole profile. Characters that are already finished unlock it when the savegame is loaded; otherwise it unlocks when the last skill reaches tier 4 (skills only gain experience while they are applied).
recon_mastery_desc: bring every warcry, boost and talent of the Recon class to its highest tier
recon_mastery_objective: Bring every warcry, boost and talent of the Recon class (2 warcries, 6 boosts, 23 talents) to tier 4. It is enough to do this on one Recon character, and it counts for the whole profile. Characters that are already finished unlock it when the savegame is loaded; otherwise it unlocks when the last skill reaches tier 4 (skills only gain experience while they are applied).
infiltrator_mastery_desc: bring every warcry, boost and talent of the Insurgent class to its highest tier
infiltrator_mastery_objective: Bring every warcry, boost and talent of the Insurgent class (2 warcries, 6 boosts, 23 talents) to tier 4. It is enough to do this on one Insurgent character, and it counts for the whole profile. Characters that are already finished unlock it when the savegame is loaded; otherwise it unlocks when the last skill reaches tier 4 (skills only gain experience while they are applied).
demolitions_mastery_desc: bring every warcry, boost and talent of the Demolitions class to its highest tier
demolitions_mastery_objective: Bring every warcry, boost and talent of the Demolitions class (2 warcries, 6 boosts, 23 talents) to tier 4. It is enough to do this on one Demolitions character, and it counts for the whole profile. Characters that are already finished unlock it when the savegame is loaded; otherwise it unlocks when the last skill reaches tier 4 (skills only gain experience while they are applied).
extra_achievs_weapon_master_desc: complete all weapon challenges of the %s
pacifist_rogues_gallery_difficulty_1_des: pacifist stealth ROGUES GALLERY on EASY
pacifist_rogues_gallery_difficulty_1_obj: finish ROGUES GALLERY in stealth, without killing anyone, but securing 2 gold, on EASY
pacifist_rogues_gallery_difficulty_2_des: pacifist stealth ROGUES GALLERY on NORMAL
pacifist_rogues_gallery_difficulty_2_obj: finish ROGUES GALLERY in stealth, without killing anyone, but securing 2 gold, on NORMAL
pacifist_rogues_gallery_difficulty_3_des: pacifist stealth ROGUES GALLERY on HARD
pacifist_rogues_gallery_difficulty_3_obj: finish ROGUES GALLERY in stealth, without killing anyone, but securing 2 gold, on HARD
pacifist_rogues_gallery_difficulty_4_des: pacifist stealth ROGUES GALLERY on VERY HARD
pacifist_rogues_gallery_difficulty_4_obj: finish ROGUES GALLERY in stealth, without killing anyone, but securing 2 gold, on VERY HARD
pacifist_enigmatic_difficulty_1_objectiv: finish ENIGMATIC in stealth, without killing anyone, on EASY
pacifist_enigmatic_difficulty_2_objectiv: finish ENIGMATIC in stealth, without killing anyone, on NORMAL
pacifist_enigmatic_difficulty_3_objectiv: finish ENIGMATIC in stealth, without killing anyone, on HARD
pacifist_enigmatic_difficulty_4_desc: pacifist stealth ENIGMATIC on VERY HARD
pacifist_enigmatic_difficulty_4_objectiv: finish ENIGMATIC in stealth, without killing anyone, on VERY HARD
pacifist_burning_man_desc: Achieve the borderline impossible: pacifist stealth BURNING MAN
pacifist_burning_man_objective: finish BURNING MAN without being detected by anyone, and without killing anyone
ouch_my_art_desc: finish ROGUES GALLERY on VERY HARD: go loud before securing any loot and secure all paintings
ouch_my_art_objective: ROGUES GALLERY on VERY HARD (raid only, not as part of an operation): the alarm must be raised before the first loot is secured, and all 6 paintings must be secured. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
tiger_hunter_desc: destroy all King Tiger tanks in TIGER TRAP on VERY HARD
tiger_hunter_objective: TIGER TRAP on VERY HARD (raid only, not as part of an operation): destroy all King Tiger tanks. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
come_and_see_desc: finish GOLD DIGGERS on VERY HARD with all gold taken, without killing a sniper
come_and_see_objective: GOLD DIGGERS on VERY HARD (raid only, not as part of an operation): take the gold of all trains and finish the mission without killing a single sniper. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
enemy_at_the_gates_desc: headshot a german sniper with the Mosin Nagant from at least 50 m
enemy_at_the_gates_objective: Any raid: kill a german sniper with a headshot from your Mosin Nagant, standing at least 50 m away. Only your own shot counts, kills by bots and teammates do not. The host decides and unlocks it for you.
shotgun_sniper_desc: headshot a german sniper with a shotgun
shotgun_sniper_objective: Any raid: kill a german sniper with a headshot from a shotgun. Only your own shot counts, kills by bots and teammates do not. The host decides and unlocks it for you.
sniper_duel_desc: headshot a german sniper with a pistol from at least 30 m
sniper_duel_objective: Any raid: kill a german sniper with a headshot from a pistol, standing at least 30 m away. Only your own shot counts, kills by bots and teammates do not. The host decides and unlocks it for you.
not_from_here_desc: kill a flamethrower trooper with a melee weapon
not_from_here_objective: Any raid: kill a flamethrower trooper with a melee weapon. Only your own kill counts. The host decides and unlocks it for you.
flying_change_desc: kill 3 enemies with 3 different weapon classes within 5 seconds
flying_change_objective: Any raid: kill enemies with three different weapon classes (e.g. rifle, pistol, melee) within 5 seconds. Only your own kills count. The host decides and unlocks it for you.
greed_killed_the_communist_desc: kill both Soviet generals in STRONGPOINT with the gold bar on HARD
greed_killed_the_communist_objective: STRONGPOINT on HARD or higher (raid only, not as part of an operation): kill both Soviet generals with the Gold Bar grenade. Kills by anyone count, as long as both were made with the gold bar. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
nazi_scalps_for_aldo_desc: kill 100 enemies with the M3 trench knife in raids on HARD or higher
nazi_scalps_for_aldo_objective: Kill 100 enemies with the M3 trench knife, counted over all raids (not operations) on HARD or higher. Only your own kills count. The host decides which kills count, so it works only if the host has this mod too.
the_game_was_rigged_name: The game was rigged from the start
the_game_was_rigged_desc: kill the officer in FULL STOP with the Parabellum P08 (Luger) on HARD
the_game_was_rigged_objective: FULL STOP on HARD or higher (raid only, not as part of an operation): kill the officer with the Parabellum P08 (Luger). The final blow counts, so a teammate or bot with a Luger also works. The host decides and unlocks it for every player in the lobby.
a_nazi_walks_into_a_bar_name: A nazi walks into a bar
a_nazi_walks_into_a_bar_desc: kill 100 enemies with the BAR or the gold bar in raids on HARD or higher
a_nazi_walks_into_a_bar_objective: Kill 100 enemies with the BAR (Browning) or the Gold Bar grenade, counted together over all raids (not operations) on HARD or higher. Only your own kills count. The host decides which kills count, so it works only if the host has this mod too.
brot_desc: stand in front of the legendary Brot store and admire it for 20 seconds
brot_objective: Stand in front of the legendary Brot store in the town of RHINEGOLD (day 2, both variants) and admire it for 20 seconds (look at it: compass heading around 30). Everyone earns this one for themselves.
